label: Zombies (Ghoulcaller Gisa): sacrifice-for-X tokens; lords; the monarch's attack drain (Marchesa's Decree); "dies or is put into exile" (God-Eternal Bontu); kicker on a creature (Josu Vess); a death replacement for opponents' creatures (Kalitas); casting from a graveyard this turn (Zul Ashur)

cards.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
gaps: {B}, {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Create X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens, where X is the sacrificed creature's power.

cards.name: Bad Moon
gaps: Black creatures get +1/+1.

cards.name: Barren Moor
gaps: Cycling {B} ({B}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

cards.name: Cemetery Reaper
gaps: Other Zombie creatures you control get +1/+1.
{2}{B}, {T}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard.
Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Cemetery Recruitment
gaps: If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.

cards.name: Champion of the Perished
gaps: Whenever another Zombie you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Consumed by Greed
gaps: Target opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control.
If the gift was promised, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Consuming Corruption
gaps: Consuming Corruption deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain X life, where X is the number of Swamps you control.

cards.name: Death Baron
gaps: Skeletons you control and other Zombies you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch. (Any amount of damage they deal to a creature is enough to destroy it.)

cards.name: Endless Ranks of the Dead
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, create X 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens, where X is half the number of Zombies you control, rounded down.

cards.name: Eternal Taskmaster
gaps: Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {2}{B}.
If you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: God-Eternal Bontu
gaps: When God-Eternal Bontu enters, sacrifice any number of other permanents, then draw that many cards.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies or is put into exile from the battlefield, you may put her into her owner's library third from the top.

cards.name: Graveborn Muse
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of Zombies you control.

cards.name: Headless Rider
gaps: Whenever this creature or another nontoken Zombie you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Infernal Idol
gaps: {1}{B}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You draw two cards and lose 2 life.

cards.name: Josu Vess, Lich Knight
gaps: When Josu Vess enters, if he was kicked, create eight 2/2 black Zombie Knight creature tokens with menace.

cards.name: Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet
gaps: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, instead exile that card and create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
{2}{B}, Sacrifice another Vampire or Zombie: Put two +1/+1 counters on Kalitas.

cards.name: Liliana's Mastery
gaps: Zombies you control get +1/+1.
When this enchantment enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Liliana's Reaver
gaps: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card and you create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Lord of the Accursed
gaps: Other Zombies you control get +1/+1.
{1}{B}, {T}: All Zombies gain menace until end of turn.

cards.name: Lord of the Undead
gaps: Other Zombie creatures get +1/+1.
{1}{B}, {T}: Return target Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Marchesa's Decree
gaps: When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
Whenever a creature attacks you or a planeswalker you control, that creature's controller loses 1 life.

cards.name: Memorial to Folly
gaps: {2}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Mire Triton
gaps: When this creature enters, mill two cards and you gain 2 life. (To mill two cards, put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Moan of the Unhallowed
gaps: Create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
Flashback {5}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Mutilate
gaps: All creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn for each Swamp you control.

cards.name: Necrotic Hex
gaps: You create six tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Noxious Ghoul
gaps: Whenever this creature or another Zombie enters, all non-Zombie creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Open the Graves
gaps: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Oversold Cemetery
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Razorlash Transmogrant
gaps: {4}{B}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
This ability costs {4} less to activate if an opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.

cards.name: Soulless One
gaps: Soulless One's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Zombies on the battlefield plus the number of Zombie cards in all graveyards.

cards.name: Syphon Flesh
gaps: Each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
You create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each creature sacrificed this way.

cards.name: Tendrils of Corruption
gaps: Tendrils of Corruption deals X damage to target creature and you gain X life, where X is the number of Swamps you control.

cards.name: Undead Augur
gaps: Whenever this creature or another Zombie you control dies, you draw a card and lose 1 life.

cards.name: Undead Butler
gaps: When this creature dies, you may exile it.
When you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Undead Warchief
gaps: Zombie spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Zombie creatures you control get +2/+1.

cards.name: Vengeful Dead
gaps: Whenever this creature or another Zombie dies, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Wight of Precinct Six
gaps: This creature gets +1/+1 for each creature card in your opponents' graveyards.

cards.name: Zul Ashur, Lich Lord
gaps: {T}: You may cast target Zombie creature card from your graveyard this turn.
